title: GMFlow
description: GMFlow (2022; the flow models of UniMatch, 2023): optical flow as one global matching step between Transformer-enhanced features of both images; variants add a second matching…
html:
GMFlow (2022; the flow models of UniMatch, 2023): optical flow as one global matching step between Transformer-enhanced features of both images; variants add a second matching scale and refinement steps. MIT code; the authors' weights carry no separate licence.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: GMFlow: Learning Optical Flow via Global Matching, CVPR 2022, 2021-11-26
  • Paper: Unifying Flow, Stereo and Depth Estimation, TPAMI 2023, 2022-11-10 (for gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-things, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-sintelft, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-kitti, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-mixdata)
  • Original code: https://github.com/autonomousvision/unimatch at 943a99006950
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/haofeixu/gmflow (PyTorch) (for gmflow-scale1-things, gmflow-scale1-mixdata, gmflow-scale2-things, gmflow-scale2-sintel, gmflow-scale2-mixdata): The authors' unimatch repository (the successor of their GMFlow code) carries the GMFlow models together with the regrefine models in one codebase.
  • Code licence: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-Apache-2.0, LICENSE-RAFT
  • Weights licence: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause (assumed from code)
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/autonomousvision/unimatch/blob/943a99006950ab6c84ea72a72beb147fdd03c19a/MODEL_ZOO.md
  • Training data: FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa) (FlyingChairs, then FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow))
    • gmflow-scale1-mixdata: MODEL_ZOO.md: "trained on several mixed public datasets" (not listed)
    • gmflow-scale2-sintel: FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, then upstream's 'sintel' stage: Sintel, KITTI 2015, HD1K and FlyingThings3D)
    • gmflow-scale2-mixdata: MODEL_ZOO.md: "trained on several mixed public datasets" (not listed)
    • gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-sintelft: FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, the 'sintel' stage (Sintel, KITTI 2015, HD1K, FlyingThings3D), then fine-tuned on Sintel)
    • gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-kitti: FlyingChairs (Freiburg), Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), not stated by the authors (FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D, Virtual KITTI 2 (no dataset entry here yet, hence 'unstated'), then KITTI 2012 + 2015 (upstream scripts/gmflow_scale2_regrefine6_train.sh, stages vkitti2 and kitti_mix))
    • gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-mixdata: MODEL_ZOO.md: "trained on several mixed public datasets" (not listed)
  • Kernel libraries: none (none of the existing kernels fits (window attention with one head, global softmax matching), and no new kernel was written for it)
  • Variants: gmflow-scale1-things, gmflow-scale1-mixdata, gmflow-scale2-things, gmflow-scale2-sintel, gmflow-scale2-mixdata, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-things, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-sintelft, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-kitti, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-mixdata
  • Outputs: flow
  • Input size:
    • gmflow-scale1-things, gmflow-scale1-mixdata: any H x W >= 64, padded to a multiple of 16
    • gmflow-scale2-things, gmflow-scale2-sintel, gmflow-scale2-mixdata, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-things, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-sintelft, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-kitti, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-mixdata: any H x W >= 64, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): gmflow-scale1-things 1024x2048 (5.4 GiB peak allocated, 6.0 reserved); gmflow-scale1-mixdata 1024x2048 (5.4 GiB peak allocated, 6.0 reserved); gmflow-scale2-things 1024x2048 (6.3 GiB peak allocated, 13.1 reserved); gmflow-scale2-sintel 1024x2048 (6.3 GiB peak allocated, 13.1 reserved); gmflow-scale2-mixdata 1024x2048 (6.3 GiB peak allocated, 13.1 reserved); gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-things 1024x2048 (6.3 GiB peak allocated, 13.1 reserved); gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-sintelft 1024x2048 (6.3 GiB peak allocated, 13.1 reserved); gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-kitti 1024x2048 (6.3 GiB peak allocated, 13.1 reserved); gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-mixdata 1024x2048 (6.3 GiB peak allocated, 13.1 reserved)
